author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the secret to overcoming loneliness isn’t complicated at all? In this inspiring talk, Natasha Hazlett reveals how the simple act of tweaking your follow through can transform acquaintances into deep, meaningful friendships no matter your age, personality type, or stage of life. Drawing on research, including the U.S. Surgeon General’s 2023 report on the Epidemic of Loneliness & Isolation, and her experience hosting nearly 200 gatherings to help women find deep, meaningful connections, she shows why so many adults get stuck in “Acquaintance Land” and how small, practical steps can help anyone create the friendships they’ve been longing for. 

Natasha Hazlett is an attorney, best-selling author, award-winning entrepreneur, and community builder. She is a wife and mom of three young kids who set out on a journey in 2023 to “find her people.” With friends now by her side, she is on a mission to help other women find their people so they too can feel seen, heard, and known. Natasha
title: How to end loneliness and make friends at any age | Natasha Hazlett | TEDxVisalia
